steps.subject: 2026 Enterprise Email Authentication & Deliverability Index for {{company}}
steps.body_html:
Hi {{first_name}},

We recently analyzed post-2024 DMARC and Yahoo/Google inbox placement metrics across 40M enterprise emails. We noticed that several domains in the {{company}} sector experienced soft-deferral cascades on port 25.

We put together a tailored benchmark showing the exact SPF/DKIM alignment and dedicated IP warmup curves required for 99.4% primary inbox placement.

Would you like me to send over the benchmark executive summary?

Best regards,
{{sender_name}}

Happy to share their anonymized audit blueprint if helpful for {{company}}.

Best,
{{sender_name}}
